nodes.title: DTMF in and out. In: carrier stream 'dtmf' events (Plivo, Exotel) and the browser socket's {t: dtmf}; keys within 1.5 s (or to '#') are one entry; 1-2 keys become the caller turn '[keypad: 1]', more keys (a PIN or OTP, maybe) are never stored or given to the brain: she says the stop-digits line and the turn records '[keypad: N keys, not shown]'. Out: when the last caller words are an automated menu ('press 1', 'दबाएं', 'dabaiye'), the LAST block teaches <dtmf N> (at most 4 keys); the runtime presses them via Plivo's send-digits API only when a menu was the last thing heard
nodes.rationale: Must-be audit 8: grep found no DTMF anywhere; IVR navigation and keypad choices were impossible.
nodes.reverse_if: real calls show carriers sending DTMF in a different event shape (then map it), or buyers need longer keypad entries passed through (an account number on purpose) with the agent's explicit permission

nodes.title: The browser test call has no keypad: the runtime accepts {t: 'dtmf', digit} on the browser socket, but web/src/browser-call.ts sends none, so a buyer cannot try a keypad choice from the studio
nodes.closes_when: the browser call view has a 12-key pad that sends {t: 'dtmf', digit}
